# Kuchup (Relocation Jobs)

> Curated visa-sponsored software engineering roles across Europe, with application tracking and Claude/Cursor MCP for CV prep.

## Product

- Public preview search on https://kuchup.com/ (no sign-in)
- Country guides for Germany, Netherlands, UK, Portugal, and Ireland
- Full board and company workspaces behind sign-in (not for indexing)
- MCP server for gated CV reframe — you submit applications yourself

## Canonical pages

- https://kuchup.com/

- https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-ireland

## Notes

- Catalog refreshes from company career pages about every six hours
- Sponsorship signals are heuristics; always confirm the live job description
- Private app surfaces (/panel, /apply, /api/) are disallowed in robots.txt
